entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure enabling UE to request modification of PDU session parameters including QoS changes, 5GSM capabilities indication, MBS multicast session management, and other session parameters.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to request release of a PDU session, used when PDU session modification cannot be initiated due to timer constraints.

entities.name: 5GSM capabilities
entities.description: Information element conveying UE capabilities including support for more than 16 packet filters, maximum data rates for user-plane integrity protection, and always-on PDU session request.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status
entities.description: Information element indicating change in PS data off status for a PDU session.

entities.name: Reflective QoS support
entities.description: Information element indicating UE support for reflective QoS, which can be revoked via PDU session modification.

entities.name: MBS multicast session
entities.description: Information element for UE to request joining or leaving multicast sessions associated with a PDU session.

entities.name: T3396
entities.description: Timer that can prevent initiation of PDU session modification procedure in certain scenarios.

entities.name: T3584
entities.description: Timer that can prevent initiation of PDU session modification procedure in certain scenarios.

entities.name: T3585
entities.description: Timer that can prevent initiation of PDU session modification procedure in certain scenarios.

entities.name: Back-off timer
entities.description: Generic back-off timer that can prevent initiation of PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
entities.description: 5GMM substate where UE cannot initiate PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: 5GMM substate where UE can initiate PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: PS data off status change condition
entities.description: Condition where UE needs to indicate change in PS data off status, allowing procedure initiation regardless of timer or location constraints.

entities.name: Reflective QoS revoke condition
entities.description: Condition where UE needs to revoke reflective QoS support but cannot initiate modification due to timer constraints.

entities.name: Inter-system change condition
entities.description: Condition occurring after inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode requiring capability indication.
